The integration of these relationships implies that Oprozomib may modulate the activity of Ephrin type-A receptor 3 through the Fes/Fps pathway. This mechanism is supported by the presence of a direct interaction between Fes/Fps and Ephrin type-A receptor 3, suggesting a potential regulatory role for Oprozomib in the downstream signaling of Ephrin type-A receptors.
